meaningKo: 너무 흥분하거나 몰입하여 상황을 잃다, 지나치게 감정적이 되다
exampleEn: I always get carried away when I talk about my favorite movies.
exampleKo: 나는 내가 좋아하는 영화에 대해 이야기할 때 항상 너무 흥분해.
gameExamples: Sometimes I get carried away with my work and forget to take breaks.
When planning the party, I tend to get carried away with the decorations and food.
